title: Ladle · Every recipe you have, ready to cook from
description: An iPhone app for the recipes in the box, the ones online, and the ones in your head. Scan them, save them, cook from them without touching the phone.
heading: Ladle
lede: Every recipe you have, in one place, laid out to cook from.
intro:
Handwritten cards, printed pages, a link from a friend, the thing you make from memory. Ladle takes all of them the same way and gives them back in one clean layout: ingredients that scale, steps big enough to read from the counter, and a pantry that knows what you can cook tonight.

Scan a card with the camera and the words are read on the phone. Share a page from Safari and it arrives formatted like everything else. Tell the pantry what is in the kitchen and the Tonight screen shows what is ready, what is one ingredient away, and what to swap for what you do not have.

sections.heading: Cook without touching it
sections.body: In cook mode, say "next", "back", "repeat" or "start timer" and it does. Ask "how much butter" and it tells you. The screen stays awake, the step fills the screen, and the ingredients it mentions sit underneath with their amounts. Siri works too, from across the room.

sections.heading: The list, the plan, the week
sections.body: Open a recipe and tap Shop: what the pantry lacks goes on the list, grouped by aisle. Plan the week and shop for all of it at once. Tick things off in the store, then move them into the pantry in one tap.

sections.heading: Yours to keep
sections.body: No account, no server, no tracking. Recipes live on the phone. Share one as a card, a text or a file that opens in Ladle on another phone, or export the whole cookbook to keep somewhere safe.

fine: Something wrong, or an idea? Write to [support@brettboggs.dev](mailto:support@brettboggs.dev). I read all of it.
